text:
sophie_partnerships: Heads-up — planning a private-offer for AstraCloud + SI bundle. Need quick alignment on commit tiers, discounting mechanics, renewal windows, and joint announcement cadence. Who's got takes?

josh_sales: Nice. Customer signal = wants 12mo commit with convert-to-reserved option. My gut: two commit bands 250k / 1M ARR-equivalent. Discounts: ~12% for 250k, ~20% for 1M. Add HW kicker (one-time credit) for top-tier.

elaine_pm: Agree on bands. One note: map committed units to token SKU + reserved GPU hours separately. Example SKU mapping (draft):
```
commit-sku: astra-commit-250k
reserved-sku: astra-dedicated-128
burst-sku: astra-burst-64
```
We need eng to confirm capacity/burst compatibility.

mike_finance: Margin constraints: we need to protect 60% gross. If we give HW kicker, cap at 10% of commit value and require 12mo prepay for the full kicker. Renewal windows: 60 days early-notice, 30 days final opt-in. Also include a usage true-up at year-end.

ana_si: From SI side — co-sell credit and onboarding funds matter. Propose 5% channel credit on committed spend, plus $10k bootcamp credit for first 10 customers. Also need a joint-case study clause in the PO.

jessie_ops: For joint announcement: recommend two-phase launch — 1) marketplace private listing + partner comms (soft launch) 2) public press 14 days later once top customers onboarded. Ops checklist: legal PSAs, marketplace listing metadata, support-runbook, and training cohort scheduled.

deploy-bot: private-offer-draft created: /marketplace/private_offers/astracloud-2026-draft (user: sophie_partnerships)

sophie_partnerships: Good notes. Two open questions: (1) do we allow unused commit to roll into Redwood Dedicated credits or expire? (2) announcement owner?

josh_sales: Prefer roll-to-dedicated credits (pro-rate) to avoid customer churn friction. Need finance sign-off. I can take announcement owner with marketing support — will coordinate press timing.

elaine_pm: Add fallback policy: if AstraCloud capacity constrained, route to hosted API variant with warning banner and automatic discount reconciliation. Also flag for eng: confirm latency SLO difference between dedicated and hosted variants.

mike_finance: Roll-to-dedicated is ok if we model worst-case payout. I'll run margin sims this afternoon. Also suggest placing a rev-rec cliff in contract: 25% non-refundable on sign.

ana_si: Legal/contract ask: SI needs explicit statement about enablement timelines for partner-delivered services (30/60/90).

jessie_ops: I'll own the ops checklist items. We should have marketplace listing + support playbook ready before the soft launch.

sophie_partnerships: Can someone drop a temp SKU mapping + proposal in the shared doc and schedule 30min sync tomorrow? 10am PT?

josh_sales: I'll create doc and invite ppl: https://redwood.internal/sales/astracloud-private-offer (draft link)

mike_finance: Count me in for the 10am PT sync. FYI quick estimate: break-even at ~18 months for 250k tier, ~9 months for 1M tier (w/ current cost assumptions).

sophie_partnerships: :thumbsup: sending calendar invite now. Thanks all — agenda: commit bands, kicker mechanics, renewal language, announcement timeline.
